prefix_review: First 1585 decoded video frames are pixel-for-pixel identical to the inspected bounded_hold video. B-frame encoding differs afterward; recovered sheets 24 through 36 were directly inspected to cover that boundary and the entire remaining sequence.
findings: Continuous acquisition and lift; real alternating walking; physically retained braking and hold; controlled lowering; forks fold before terrain transfer while palms/thumbs retain; weight transfers to terrain; palms/thumbs open; both hands withdraw; robot rises into a stable crouched recovery with feet supporting and box stationary. Bounded grasp rocking is visible, no ejection or drop. All phases are covered.
grasp_review_note: Measured material-point tangential excursions 13.14 / 5.31 mm end at 7.19 / 1.17 mm. Video and physical contact history show bounded rocking and settling, without progressive extraction, spinning, ejection, loss of grasp or ballistic carry. Nonzero motion is explicitly reported.
